description: Assemble a [...] regex character class from named building blocks (lowercase, uppercase, digits, whitespace), custom character ranges, and literal custom characters, with optional negation. Pure string assembly, it never runs the resulting pattern against any input.

customChars.description: Literal characters to include as-is; duplicates are ignored

customRanges.description: Custom ranges like "f-k", each exactly two characters joined by a hyphen

negate.description: Wrap the class in [^...] to match any character NOT in the set

name: build_character_class
